sonnet.problem: The statement bundles two claims: that Jonah sank to the roots of the mountains and was barred in, and that the LORD left his life in the pit. A baker who sees the first half is true has to weigh a second claim in the same statement.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The two wrong answers mean the same thing: both say Jonah gives up on God (stop calling out, hide for good). Both also start with 'Yes' while the right answer starts with 'No', so the right answer is the odd one out.
sonnet.rule: Two wrong answers never mean the same as each other either.
